title: Settings
motionHint: Reduced and Off also respect your operating system's “reduce motion” preference. Animations never delay actions.
ambientHint: A very slow background ambience behind the interface — each theme has its own character. Functional transitions keep working even with ambience off, and the background never animates when your OS requests reduced motion.
languageHint: Only languages marked “Complete” cover the whole interface. Others are partial and fall back to English.
diagnosticsHint: Contains versions, settings and storage counts only — never incident details, names, contacts or coordinates.
updateCheckFailed: Couldn't check right now (you may be offline).
workspaceHint: Reporter keeps navigation focused on reporting and your own records. Professional adds the response dashboard and network tools. Switching never deletes or alters records, and is not an authorization system.
notificationsNote: The app confirms important actions with a brief in-app notification (with Undo where safe). It does not send push notifications, emails or any outbound messages.
backupHint: Backups include all incidents and photos in a versioned JSON file. Importing never overwrites existing incidents with the same ID — duplicates are skipped and reported.
storageWarning: Clearing browser data (site data / storage) will permanently delete local incidents. There is no cloud copy. Export a backup before clearing data or switching devices.
statusReferenceHint: All incident statuses side by side for visual comparison in this theme.
emergencyNote: If there is immediate danger to people, contact your local emergency service. Emergency numbers differ by country — this app intentionally does not display a specific number.
profileBlurb: Saved details pre-fill new reports for convenience. You always choose whether they are actually included when creating or sharing a report — nothing is sent, shared or submitted automatically.
profileLocal: Stored locally on this device. Pre-fills reports only — final report privacy controls decide what is shared.
profilePhoneUnknown: Will be saved exactly as typed — it doesn't look like a complete international number.
notifDeliveryHint: Notifications are generated locally from your own records. There is no push, email or server delivery yet.
notifQuietEnable: Silence in-app notifications during quiet hours
notifQuietHint: During quiet hours notifications are still recorded in the bell menu, but no toast appears.
notifEmpty: No notifications yet. Activity from your records will appear here.
notifLocalOnly: Local notifications from your own records — no server push.
mapPrivacyHint: When online maps are on, your map viewport (not your reports) is sent to the tile provider to draw the map. Incident coordinates are never uploaded.
mapOfflineHint: Off means maps show incident positions locally without downloading any tiles. Useful on metered connections or for maximum privacy.
resetReplayHint: Shows first-run setup again. Does not delete any reports.
resetTutorialsHint: Resets the Interface Tour, Guide Me, Guided First Report and demo tutorial state. Does not delete incidents.
resetPreviewHint: Shows onboarding temporarily without modifying your saved settings or reports.
resetFactoryWarn: Factory reset permanently deletes ALL local application data — every incident, photo, draft and setting. There is no cloud copy.
profRolesBlurb: Roles tailor the professional workspace. Nothing here is verification — until a connected organization verifies you server-side, every role is labeled Professional Preview.
profRolesPreview: All roles shown are Professional Preview (local). Verified roles will be issued by a real response organization.
roleAddedPreview: Role added as a local preview role — not verified
roleRemoveBody: This removes the role from your local workspace. It does not delete any incidents. You can add it back later.
devPreviewLocales: Developer preview: show incomplete languages and the pseudo-locale
mapProviderPolicy: Public community infrastructure — the app only requests viewport tiles, never uploads incident data, and falls back to the offline provider instead of retrying aggressively.
syncBlurb: Sync incident records with other computers running this app on the same local network. No internet, no cloud — devices talk directly to each other.
syncEnable: Sync with devices on this network
syncPeerHint: Copy “Your address” into the other device's list. Both sides must add each other.
syncUnavailableBrowser: LAN sync runs in the desktop (Windows) app only — the browser/PWA build has no local server. Install the desktop version to sync devices on the same network.
syncMediaNote: v1 syncs incident records (text, timeline, contacts, privacy settings). Photo and video files are not synced yet — use backups to move media.
syncTrustNote: Only add devices you trust: a synced peer receives full records, including private notes.
testViewBanner: Test view — fictional demo incidents are mixed into this dashboard for training. Nothing here touches real records, and exports keep their fictional-demo labels.
photoHint: Shown only in your sidebar, on this device.
photoNotImage: That file is not an image
